## 本周报道 | This week’s report

**中文。** 北京市文物局本周发布的官方稿，汇集南老君堂、西大桥、琉璃河、丰台沉船与大岭沟等成果。其中，大岭沟戍堡被报告为主要属于北齐、隋代，并在金代延用；丰台船只则是较早发掘材料的公布。本期把它作为本周新增的官方报道，不将其改写成全部发现均发生于本周。

**English.** The bureau’s weekly release brings together work at Nanlaojuntang, Xidaqiao, Liulihe, the Fengtai boats and Dalinggou. It attributes the main Dalinggou fort phases to Northern Qi and Sui, with later Jin use. The boats were excavated earlier. This is a newly linked official report, not a claim that all the finds were made this week.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 成果交流活动于 2026-10-31 举行；大岭沟发掘为 2026-08 至 2026-10，丰台船只发掘为 2025-11 至 2025-12。

**English.** The presentation took place on 2026-10-31; Dalinggou fieldwork ran from 2026-08 to 2026-10, while the Fengtai boats were excavated from 2025-11 to 2025-12.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 官方稿的网页日期晚于成果交流活动日期；“北京首次发现隋代长城”是地区性判断，不是世界范围的首次。各项目的首次公布历史仍需分别复核。

**English.** The webpage postdates the presentation. The Sui-wall firstness claim is regional to Beijing, not global. Earlier announcement histories require separate project-level checks.
